author: Cocoyote
quote: Replayed this again and it's truly just ashamed how they never properly reviewed this game, there was so much fluff at the time, this game is not as good as they claim.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Cocoyote
quote: This might be the weakest Zelda I ever played, this game is way to easy to be a game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Cocoyote
quote:
Yes,  the hype is real, and absolutely nothing short of outstanding, this game has captured and encapsulates everything that is fun about gaming, you can do and go anywhere and do whatever you little heart desires, this is what gaming is all about. 
10/10
